_meta.semantics: covers_syllabus_refs is an index of the objectives a stage is principally associated with; coverage is claimed only through _syllabus_items + covers_items, and only as far as coverage_check.py confirms.

_items_source.document: Loughborough University Biomedical Engineering BEng (Hons) programme page (course overview, entry requirements and year-by-year compulsory/optional module lists), cross-checked against the QAA Subject Benchmark Statement for Engineering (5th edition, March 2023)
_items_source.version: Programme page and module lists as published live at lboro.ac.uk, read 2026-09-27 (2026-27 entry cycle).
_items_source.numbering: Loughborough's own module-code numbering (e.g. specific module codes within its Department of Mechanical, Electrical and Manufacturing Engineering / Wolfson School catalogue) sits behind the institution's internal module catalogue and student portal and was not accessible from the open web; this course keeps its own stable id scheme per topic area (e.g. AP-1, BM1-1) rather than inventing Loughborough-style codes, and records that fact honestly here. Real Loughborough module titles are used throughout material_vintage and the stage-to-module mapping below.
